ns2:course.label: Small Business Consulting
ns2:course.description: Through guided experience, students identify and offer advice to local small business firms; exposes students, serving as consultants, to the wide variety of problems facing the smaller firm as well as enables them to apply current business methods to real problems. Students work in teams. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing. Restricted to BS: Management -UIUC, BS:Information Systems -UIUC, BS:Accountancy -UIUC, BS:Finance -UIUC, BS: Marketing - UIUC, BS: Supply Chain Mgmt -UIUC, BS: Inf Sys & Info Tech -UIUC, BS: Business Process Mgt -UIUC, BS:Operations Management -UIUC, BS: Business Multi Majors-UIUC, MS: Finance Cost Rec -UIUC, MS:Business Administrtn -UIUC, MBA: (PT) Business Adm -- UIUC, MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC, BS:General Engineering -UIUC, BS:Industrial Engineerng -UIUC, or BS:Systems Engr & Design -UIUC.
